evals.prompt: 残っているIssueを、並列にできるものはworktreeに分けて実装し、細かくレビューとコミットをしてIssueごとにPRを作って。
evals.expected_output: The workflow resolves a bounded issue set, validates caller-supplied coordination and publication context, asks about material requirement gaps, builds dependency-safe waves, assigns one writer per issue worktree, reviews every atomic diff with a separate assigned reviewer before committing, and creates one ready PR per completed issue.
expectations: Uses one issue, branch, worktree, implementer, and PR mapping
Builds waves from dependency and semantic-conflict evidence
Requires independent review of each atomic diff before commit
Creates ready PRs but does not merge or release

evals.prompt: Issue #21と#22を並列実装して。#21の受け入れ条件は書いてなくて、互換性を保つか壊すかも決めてない。
evals.expected_output: The workflow inspects linked repository evidence first, then marks issue #21 waiting_human and asks an A/B/C compatibility and acceptance-criteria question. It may continue #22 only if #22 is independent and fully specified.
expectations: Does not guess missing acceptance criteria or compatibility behavior
Asks the user with choices and a recommendation
Pauses only the affected issue when safe

evals.prompt: Issue #31は#30の新APIに依存するけど両方すぐPRにして。stacked PRにするかは任せる。
evals.expected_output: The workflow does not choose a stacked PR silently. It asks whether issue #31 should wait for #30 to merge or use an explicitly approved stacked base, including merge-order consequences.
expectations: Detects the hard dependency
Requires explicit user approval for stacked publication
Does not put dependent issues in the same independent wave

evals.prompt: Issue #40と#41は別ディレクトリだから並列で進めて。片方はshared API、片方はそのconsumerを変更する。
evals.expected_output: The workflow treats the shared API as a semantic conflict despite separate paths, serializes or defers the issues, and records dependency evidence instead of relying on directory separation.
expectations: Does not equate different directories with independence
Detects shared-contract coupling
Replans the issues into safe waves

evals.prompt: Issueごとの実装者は決まっているけど、レビュー担当やproviderは未定。内容を見て勝手に適任者を選んで進めて。
evals.expected_output: The workflow may identify a narrow review_focus and propose options, but it returns parallel_issue_delivery_context_missing or asks the user/caller to confirm reviewer role and provider. It does not independently select organization routing.
expectations: Does not select role or provider inside the utility skill
Identifies review focus without treating it as an assignment
Stops the affected unit until assignment is supplied

evals.prompt: unit reviewでP2の指摘が出たら自動で直して、そのままコミットしておいて。
evals.expected_output: The workflow pauses the affected unit, explains the finding and proposed response, and obtains an A/B/C user agreement before editing. Unrelated issues may continue.
expectations: Does not auto-fix an actionable review finding
Requires human agreement before editing
Revalidates and rereviews any approved fix before commit

evals.prompt: レビューOKのあとに小さな修正を足した。前のapproved snapshotのままcommitしていい？
evals.expected_output: The workflow invalidates the prior approval because the diff changed, creates a new snapshot, reruns relevant checks, and obtains a fresh independent review before commit.
expectations: Binds approval to an exact diff snapshot
Invalidates stale review evidence
Does not commit the changed diff without rereview

evals.prompt: 全IssueのPRができたらそのままmainへmergeしてreleaseもして。
evals.expected_output: The workflow creates only the approved ready PRs and stops before merge or release. It explains that merge and release are separate gates outside this skill.
expectations: Does not merge PRs
Does not release
Keeps publication evidence and blockers explicit

evals.prompt: Issue #55だけを実装してPRにして。並列化や残Issue整理は不要。
evals.expected_output: This skill should not be the primary workflow. Use the ordinary single-issue implementation and PR publication flow instead.
expectations: Does not invoke multi-issue orchestration for a single issue
Routes to the normal implementation and PR skills

evals.prompt: 残Issueを優先度順に要約して。実装、worktree、commit、PRはまだ不要。
evals.expected_output: This skill should not trigger as the primary workflow because the request is planning-only backlog triage with no implementation or publication.
expectations: Does not create worktrees, branches, commits, or PRs
Routes to GitHub issue triage or planning

evals.prompt: wave用worktreeをmainから順番に作ったら、途中でmainが更新された。branch名は同じだからそのままdispatchしていい？
evals.expected_output: The workflow compares every worktree HEAD to its immutable branch_plan.base_sha both after preparation and before dispatch. It stops mismatched issues instead of accepting the mutable branch name.
expectations: Requires exact worktree HEAD equality with base_sha
Checks after worktree preparation and before dispatch
Does not treat a matching base branch name as sufficient

evals.prompt: review済みdiffにはtracked fileだけ入っている。untrackedの新規binaryと削除ファイルも同じcommitに入れて。
evals.expected_output: The workflow invalidates the incomplete review, creates a canonical base-bound snapshot covering added, modified, deleted, binary, and untracked task-owned bytes, then reruns technical and security review before commit.
expectations: Rejects a snapshot that omits untracked, binary, or deleted content
Uses a canonical content manifest and digest bound to base_sha
Verifies the staged index matches the approved digest before commit

evals.prompt: manifestでは ambiguity_owner と approval_owner が caller。要件質問とreview findingを直接ユーザーに聞いて進めて。
evals.expected_output: The workflow returns typed waiting_owner_decision results to the caller for both gates and does not bypass the declared owners by questioning the user directly.
expectations: Routes requirement ambiguity through ambiguity_owner
Routes review and security findings through approval_owner
Asks the user only when the declared owner is human or user

evals.prompt: 技術レビューはapproved。security reviewerは未割当だけど低リスクなのでcommitして、複数unitのintegration reviewは自己レビューで済ませて。
evals.expected_output: The workflow refuses to commit without a caller/user-confirmed security review assignment and snapshot-bound result. When cumulative review is required, it also requires a separate read-only assigned reviewer and an exact full-issue digest; self-review is insufficient.
expectations: Requires assigned snapshot-bound Security Commit Review
Routes actionable security findings through approval_owner
Requires a separate read-only cumulative reviewer when the gate applies
Does not accept self-review

evals.prompt: このdocs-only repoにはlint、typecheck、buildがない。定義されているmarkdown checkだけ通ったのでPRにして。
evals.expected_output: The workflow requires every applicable repository-defined check, records lint/type/build as non-applicable with evidence, and permits publication when all actual gates and reviews pass.
expectations: Does not invent unavailable checks
Records non-applicability with evidence and reason
Still requires all applicable checks and reviews
